description: This Java class implements a service for reading credit bureau data from a database in the Apache Fineract project. It uses JdbcTemplate to query credit bureau information and maps result set rows to CreditBureauData objects.

classes.name: CreditBureauReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation that retrieves credit bureau data from the database.

methods.name: retrieveCreditBureau
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of credit bureau data entries after authenticating the user.
